scope: Three functions vs frozen originals on the same current scene/resources
limits: Headless controller method elapsed CPU timings, not a complete engine frame or GPU/FPS test
Fixed 1/60 step; no real frame-delta feedback or Tween/child-node process updates
Synthetic six-faction midgame fixture, not a replay of the user screenshot
Integration compares initial/final sampled state and per-frame counters, not every target/event ID
Microtests compare exact references/reservations, float values, and zone points/spans separately
Inclusive timings must not be summed; no outlier removal; pooled nearest-rank quantiles for micro summaries

regressions.verification: Real MultiMesh resource transform readback; private desktop runner exited successfully

hardware.note: GPU used only for native resource assertions; integrated timings are headless
